subject.title: [Bug]: Bootstrap files in agentDir are silently ignored — only workspace directory files are injected into system prompt

question: Should configured agentDir files become prompt-authoritative bootstrap context, or should OpenClaw keep workspace-only bootstrap and warn when bootstrap files are misplaced in agentDir?
rationale: Both choices are plausible, but they set different security and upgrade boundaries for AGENTS.md/SOUL.md authority; automation should not choose that policy while three linked PRs already implement competing approaches.

options.title: Confirm Warning-Only Policy
options.body: Land a cleaned warning-only PR such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97653 and document that bootstrap files belong in workspace, leaving per-agent prompt authority out of agentDir.

options.title: Adopt AgentDir Bootstrap Authority
options.body: Land an agentDir-loading PR only after docs, doctor diagnostics, precedence tests, and upgrade proof make the new prompt authority explicit.

options.title: Keep Open For Design
options.body: Pause all linked PRs until maintainers define a broader per-agent workspace/bootstrap model instead of choosing from the current implementations.

recommendation.title: Confirm Warning-Only Policy
recommendation.body: Land a cleaned warning-only PR such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97653 and document that bootstrap files belong in workspace, leaving per-agent prompt authority out of agentDir.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest feature-history trail across bootstrap resolution and multi-agent routing, so he is the best available owner for the policy choice.
